title: Developer API
intro: Connect your tools with scoped workspace keys and a versioned public API.
adminOnly: Only workspace owners and admins can manage API keys.
name: Key name
scopeHelp: Choose only the permissions your integration needs. These keys access the public API. Creating contacts does not grant marketing consent.
secretHelp: This secret appears once. Store it in your server's secret settings. Closing this page hides it permanently.
loadError: Could not load API keys. Use Refresh keys to retry.
empty: No API keys yet. Create one to connect an integration.
actionError: Could not complete this change. Refresh keys before retrying a creation; a key may already have been created. Copy the secret manually if clipboard access is unavailable.
revokePrompt: Revoke this key? Integrations using it will lose access immediately.
baseHelp: Use your dashboard's origin plus this base path. A directly exposed API server uses /api/v1/public instead.
authHelp: Send Authorization: Bearer <api key> on each request. Session cookies do not authenticate the public API.
paginationHelp: List responses contain items, next_cursor and limit. Pass cursor and limit on the next request; limit is at most 100. Keep filters unchanged.
replayHelp: Every POST requires a unique Idempotency-Key (1–128 characters). Repeating the same request within 24 hours returns its original result. Reusing a key for another request returns 409.
rateHelp: All keys share the workspace plan's per-minute quota. A 429 response includes Retry-After. Wait before retrying; the quota also counts replays.
jobsHelp: Source and Q&A writes return 202. Poll the returned operation until complete or failed. JSON source uploads support text and Markdown.
sendHelp: Send text or approved templates through POST /messages. WhatsApp sends are queued; existing consent and 24-hour reply-window rules apply. Read delivery status using a separate conversations:read key permission.
runHelp: Evaluation runs require evals:write and confirm_cost: true. They use configured models and may incur usage charges. Poll the run for results.
versionHelp: Breaking changes require a new API version and at least six months of notice. Additive fields may appear in v1.
exampleHelp: Set API_BASE to the public API base URL and API_KEY to a server-side secret. Never embed keys in browser code.
